options.content:
## By question (visualization layout)
One row per **question × approach × device** (latest answer **in the time range**). The time picker is applied — a CPU-only session will not keep showing an older CUDA run. Use **Device** to further filter. Sort the table by `question` to compare baseline|cpu, rag|cpu, etc.

panels.title: Run — what you are looking at
panels.description: The selected run's identity, per device leg. `run_id` matches `results/runs/<run_id>/` on disk. Rows written before run identity was added to the schema have no run_id and are excluded from every panel here.

targets.rawSql:
-- One row per device leg of the selected run. Rows written before run_id
-- existed have no run and never appear here.
SELECT run_id,
       MIN(run_started_at) AS run_started_at,
       COALESCE(device, 'unknown') AS device,
       COALESCE(MAX(runtime), 'transformers') AS runtime,
       MAX(model_name) AS model,
       COUNT(DISTINCT question) AS questions,
       COUNT(*) AS answers,
       ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(timestamp) - MIN(timestamp)))::numeric, 1) AS wall_s,
       'results/runs/' || run_id || '/' AS export_folder
FROM evaluation_metrics
WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL AND split_part(run_id, '_', 1) || '_' || split_part(run_id, '_', 2) = ${run:sqlstring}
GROUP BY run_id, COALESCE(device, 'unknown')
ORDER BY run_id

SELECT LEFT(question, 100) AS question,
       CASE approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'Baseline'
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 'Baseline (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 'RAG'
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 'RAG (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 'Fine-tuned'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 'Fine-tuned + RAG'
           ELSE approach END AS approach,
       COALESCE(device, 'unknown') AS device,
       ROUND("rougeL"::numeric, 3) AS rouge_l,
       ROUND(quality_score::numeric, 3) AS quality,
       ROUND(bert_score::numeric, 3) AS bert,
       ROUND(faithfulness::numeric, 3) AS faithfulness,
       ROUND(COALESCE(time_to_response, generation_time + COALESCE(retrieval_time, 0))::numeric, 2) AS time_to_response,
       ROUND(COALESCE(tokens_per_sec, 0)::numeric, 2) AS tok_per_sec,
       LEFT(REPLACE(COALESCE(response, ''), E'\n', ' '), 120) AS answer_preview
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (question, approach, COALESCE(device, 'unknown'))
         question, approach, device, quality_score, "rougeL", bert_score, faithfulness,
         time_to_response, generation_time, retrieval_time,
         tokens_per_sec, response, timestamp
  FROM evaluation_metrics
  WHERE question IS NOT NULL
    AND run_id IS NOT NULL AND split_part(run_id, '_', 1) || '_' || split_part(run_id, '_', 2) = ${run:sqlstring}
    AND COALESCE(device, 'unknown') IN ($device)
  ORDER BY question, approach, COALESCE(device, 'unknown'), timestamp DESC
) t
ORDER BY question, CASE approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 1
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 2
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 3
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 4
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 5
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 6
           ELSE 7 END, device

-- Both legs are pinned to the selected run: the CPU and GPU rows come from
-- <stamp>_cpu and <stamp>_cuda, which share the <stamp> the run picker lists.
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (question, approach, COALESCE(device, 'unknown'))
         question, approach, COALESCE(device, 'unknown') AS device,
         COALESCE(time_to_response, generation_time + COALESCE(retrieval_time, 0)) AS ttr
  FROM evaluation_metrics
  WHERE question IS NOT NULL AND generation_time IS NOT NULL
    AND run_id IS NOT NULL AND split_part(run_id, '_', 1) || '_' || split_part(run_id, '_', 2) = ${run:sqlstring}
    AND COALESCE(device, 'unknown') IN ($device)
  ORDER BY question, approach, COALESCE(device, 'unknown'), timestamp DESC
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT question, approach,
         MAX(ttr) FILTER (WHERE device = 'cpu') AS cpu_sec,
         MAX(ttr) FILTER (WHERE device IN ('cuda', 'gpu')) AS gpu_sec
  FROM latest
  GROUP BY question, approach
)
SELECT LEFT(question, 80) AS question,
       CASE approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'Baseline'
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 'Baseline (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 'RAG'
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 'RAG (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 'Fine-tuned'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 'Fine-tuned + RAG'
           ELSE approach END AS approach,
       ROUND(cpu_sec::numeric, 2) AS cpu_time_to_response,
       ROUND(gpu_sec::numeric, 2) AS gpu_time_to_response,
       ROUND((cpu_sec / NULLIF(gpu_sec, 0))::numeric, 2) AS gpu_speedup_x
FROM pivot
WHERE cpu_sec IS NOT NULL AND gpu_sec IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY question, CASE approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 1
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 2
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 3
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 4
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 5
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 6
           ELSE 7 END
